summary: Iteration 10 - Phase 5 WhatsApp (Evolution API, not configured) + message campaigns + iteration-9 fix verification. Backend: new suite backend_test_v10_whatsapp.py 30/31 pass; regression v8+v9 100/100 pass (v9 already handled campaign start under callerdesk provider). Verified: /whatsapp/status (admin webhook_url https://.../webhook/tasko?secret=..., configured=false; manager/exec webhook_url null), PATCH settings manager 403, qrcode 400 'not connected'; webhook wrong secret 401, unknown org 404, invalid JSON 400, connection.update ignored, messages.upsert stored once (dedupe on resend), appears in lead messages + conversations (lead_name/last_text/unread/opaque id), 'New WhatsApp message' notification for owner, imageMessage -> type image + caption, skyline webhook isolated (own secret, tasko secret 401 on skyline, no cross-org data). Masking: manager/exec number masked (e.g. 98XXXXXX12), remote_jid absent in messages + conversations; admin full. Exec scope: only own chats, other exec's chat messages GET/POST 403, other's lead whatsapp 403; unknown chat 404; search works. Send/sync -> 400 not connected, empty body 400, /whatsapp/sync exec 403. Message campaigns: list admin/manager 200, exec 403; whatsapp -> 400 'Connect WhatsApp'; no stage/lead_ids 400; bad channel 422; email via Resend returns {total:2,sent:0,failed:2,skipped:0} (Resend test mode) and doc listed. Iter-9 fixes: campaign start under twilio 400, CallerDesk webhook invalid JSON 400 and talk_duration 'abc' -> 200, reports exclude pending_credentials (code verified). Frontend (Playwright 1920): nav-whatsapp -> /whatsapp, search, chat click -> /whatsapp/<chatId>, bubbles, input/send/attach, send -> error toast, wa-open-lead navigates; admin settings panel all testids, state 'not connected', webhook url shown, QR -> error toast; manager no settings toggle, chat header number masked; lead detail section/chat/sync/attach/input/send + wa-not-configured banner, lead-whatsapp-btn scrolls (admin+manager), sync/send toasts; CallerDesk Message Campaigns tab all testids, subject only for email, WA campaign -> error toast, list renders. Executive /callerdesk and /callerdesk/message-campaigns -> '/', no toasts; manager /callerdesk/settings -> /callerdesk/dashboard; report-user hidden for exec; calendar-day testids match local dates.

minor.issue: Returns 500 when JSON body is not an object (e.g. a list) - AttributeError 'list' has no attribute 'get' at whatsapp.py:272. Also data items that are not dicts would 500. Add isinstance(payload, dict) check -> 400.

Chats keep stale lead_id/lead_name after the lead is deleted; 'Open lead' then 404s. Also executive scoping relies on chat.lead_id set at last message time; chats received before lead creation are only linked on the next message.

Auto-created leads are named 'Inbound caller <full 10-digit phone>' - the full number leaks to masked roles (manager/exec) via lead name everywhere (WhatsApp inbox list/header, leads list). Use a masked/neutral name.

Failure reasons swallowed (bare except -> failed++); no per-recipient error stored, so admin can't see why 2/2 failed. Sends are synchronous in-request for up to 1000 leads (timeout risk); no throttle for WhatsApp bulk (ban risk). Unknown stage silently creates a 0-total campaign.
Returns array without 'configured' flag, so the Inbox chat never shows the wa-not-configured banner (only lead chat does).

ui_bugs.issue: Pane uses 'flex-1 overflow-y-auto h-[...]' inside an auto-height flex-col: flex-basis 0 overrides the fixed height, so pane collapses to content (measured 92px instead of 480px in Inbox; ~80px vs 320px in lead). With long conversations it will grow unbounded with no inner scroll. Fix: drop flex-1 (or add shrink-0 / set height on outer container).

Opening a deleted lead (e.g. via stale WhatsApp chat 'Open lead') throws uncaught AxiosError 404 (Promise.all in load() at LeadDetail.jsx:282 has no try/catch) -> runtime error overlay / blank page. Add catch + 'Lead not found' state.

issues: mc-channel/mc-stage are native <select> elements (inconsistent with shadcn Select used elsewhere)
Stage options show raw lowercase values (site_visit -> 'site visit' lowercase)
Empty chat pane looks squashed (see pane height bug)

action_items: WhatsApp webhook: reject non-dict JSON payload / non-dict data items with 400 instead of 500
Fix WhatsAppChat pane height (remove flex-1 so fixed h-[..] applies and inner scroll works)
LeadDetail: catch 404 on load and show not-found state
Unlink/clean wa_chats lead_id when a lead is deleted (or verify lead exists in conversations list)
Don't embed full phone in auto-created 'Inbound caller <phone>' lead names (masking leak)
Message campaigns: record failure reason, consider background job + throttling
critical_code_review_comments: whatsapp.py store_message lead match uses regex on last 10 digits of stored phone - fails if lead phone stored with spaces/dashes ('+91 98765 43210'); normalize phone digits on save or store phone_digits field
whatsapp.py webhook notification uses type='lead_assigned' for WhatsApp messages - use a dedicated type
wa_cfg() creates and persists webhook secret lazily on any read incl. unauthenticated webhook path - fine but no rotate endpoint
_send for campaigns calls store_message + log_activity per lead sequentially; 1000 leads in a single HTTP request will time out behind ingress
Inbox WhatsAppChat polls every 15s and chat list every 20s per tab - acceptable but no backoff on errors (toast spam on repeated failures)

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows/testids work; chat pane height + LeadDetail 404 crash)
